scope: Additional independent, source-bound headless review. This is supplemental to reproducible per-family audits, and does not claim browser QA.

resolvedDefects.description: Completed or interrupted solution replay could be reloaded as an unaided attempt, promoting demo progress to won.
resolvedDefects.fix: Session v2 persists hint/replay/unknown assistance; undo and load retain it; legacy v1 challenge saves migrate conservatively. Display scopes also corrected for two-/three-player games.
resolvedDefects.coverage: All ten card games: completed/repeated reload; interrupted replay/manual continuation; undo/reload; genuine unaided completion preservation.

limitations: Actual browser rendering, responsive touch layouts, and real worker scheduling remain separate uncompleted gates.
Finite independent oracle/fuzz coverage does not prove every possible state or perfect AI strength.
Eight non-chess/shogi board challenge sets are disclosed local tactical drills, rather than forced whole-game wins.

resolvedDefects.issue: Value complement v→n²+1−v followed by D4 rotation/reflection made 001 and 006 equivalent.
resolvedDefects.resolution: Owner added complement normalization, regenerated affected corpus, and audit independently verified100.

resolvedDefects.issue: gap(d=0) and eq described the same atomic constraint;010,014,015 collapsed under public-constraint symmetries.
resolvedDefects.resolution: Owner normalized zero-gap to equality, regenerated only logic-grid, and audit independently verified100.

limitations: Actual desktop/narrow browser rendering, native hitboxes and real touch behavior remain untested.
Finite models use the visible declared rules, including discrete tether wrapping, voxel projections, static beam balance and abstract layered gear axes.
Progression is tier-based, rather than a claim that every adjacent level has strictly increasing human difficulty.

resolvedFindings: Solution viewing now persists assistance across reload; cannot earn independent win from the same attempt.
Space-dodge touch release, cancellation and lost-capture stop motion.
All management games survive bfcache return; tower autoplay pauses on blur and persisted pagehide.
Pinball constant launch+both-flippers no longer wins any of 100 levels; powered strikes require recent rising-edge presses.
Fruit-slice pointerdown without pointermove no longer cuts; actual manual pointer replays now reproduce all sampled wins.
limitations: Real-browser visual layout, native event/touch behavior and human difficulty playtests were not run; offline/VM results do not substitute for these.
Pinball remains forgiving: blind both-flipper on6/off6-tick pulses win 99/100. This is a human difficulty-QA caveat, not a remaining rules/proof blocker.
Two Breakout DOM replays differ from exact certificate hashes solely by floating-point coordinate conversion; all fields match within 1e-6, goals, event structure and final ticks match.

Independent action checker verifies goals, control bounds, event conditions and analytic trajectories where applicable; it is not a complete separately written collision integrator for every action game.
managementAndAction.proofIntegrity: Independent harnesses never invoke bot, generator, owner independent.cjs or management reference.cjs. Stored inputs are replayed through shipped engines and actual shipped HTML controls; independent goals and ledgers determine acceptance.
